DR04 is a specific medical diagnosis code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify bleeding from the airways (respiratory tract) [^src1]. It plays a targeted role in the national clinical quality monitoring of patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. Specifically, the code is utilized as part of a broader set of diagnostic criteria to measure the incidence of severe bleeding events among this patient population [^src1].

In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram, or RKKP), tracking severe bleeding is a critical quality indicator for evaluating the safety of treatments, such as anticoagulants, prescribed to atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. To capture these events comprehensively, the database employs a wide array of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes [^src1]. DR04 is grouped alongside other specific codes like [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], and [[dr31|DR31]] to track urinary tract and pulmonary (lung/airway) bleeding [^src1]. This is distinct from the codes used to track intracranial bleeding (such as [[di60|DI60]] through [[ds066|DS066]]) and gastrointestinal bleeding (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) [^src1].

The definition and methodological application of DR04 and its associated indicators are formally documented in the annual reports for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, serving as a technical reference for standardized data collection and cross-regional comparison across the country's healthcare system [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
